vocab.definition: a metal in the central block of the periodic table.
a substance that speeds up a reaction unchanged.
transition metals can form ions of different charges.
many transition metal compounds are coloured.

misconceptions.wrong: Transition metals react like Group 1 metals.
misconceptions.right: They are much less reactive than Group 1.

misconceptions.wrong: They always form ions with charge 1+.
misconceptions.right: They can form ions of several different charges.
Many of their compounds are brightly coloured.

infoPanels.title: GROUP 1 vs TRANSITION METALS
workedSteps: Group 1: soft, low density, very reactive.
Group 1: form only 1+ ions, white compounds.
Transition metals are often used as catalysts.

footer.tip: Transition metals: hard, dense, less reactive, coloured compounds, good catalysts.
